intro_en: You will practice giving and asking for advice in a student forum, using campus words and the conditional endings -вал/-вэл/-бал/-бэл. You will also review the English first conditional and 'unless'.
intro_mn: Та оюутны форумд зөвлөгөө өгөх, асуух дадлага хийж, оюутны амьдралын үгс болон -вал/-вэл/-бал/-бэл нөхцөлийн залгаврыг давтана. Мөн англи хэлний first conditional болон 'unless'-ийг давтана.

vocab.example_en: I am looking for a part-time job.
He did an internship at a bank in the summer.
I keep worrying because of the exam.
It is better to rest on the weekend.
An internship will be good experience.
They accepted me for the internship.

sentences.mn: Хэрвээ цагийн ажил хийвэл бага унтана.
sentences.en: If you work a part-time job, you will sleep less.
alt_en: If I work a part-time job, I will sleep less.
sentences.mn_latin: Khervee tsagiin ajil khiivel baga untana.

sentences.en: If you do an internship, you will gain experience.
alt_en: If you do an internship, you'll get experience.

sentences.en: If you worry too much, you will get sick.
alt_en: If you worry too much, you'll get ill.

sentences.en: If you don't rest well, you will get tired.
alt_en: Unless you rest well, you will get tired.

sentences.mn: Хэрэв цагийн хуваариа сайн гаргавал бүх зүйлд амжина.
sentences.en: If you plan your schedule well, you will manage everything.
alt_en: If you make a good schedule, you'll have time for everything.
sentences.mn_latin: Kherev tsagiin khuvaaria sain gargaval bükh züild amjina.

sentences.en: If you ask the teacher, they will help you.
alt_en: If you ask the teacher, he or she will help you.

sentences.mn: Би маргааш чөлөөтэй бол цагийн ажилд очно.
sentences.en: If I am free tomorrow, I will go to my part-time job.
alt_en: If I'm free tomorrow, I'll go to work.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi margaash chölöötei bol tsagiin ajild ochno.

sentences.mn: Та надтай зөвлөлдвөл би баяртай байх болно.
sentences.en: I will be glad if you consult with me.
alt_en: If you talk it over with me, I'll be happy.
sentences.mn_latin: Ta nadtai zövlöldvöl bi bayartai baikh bolno.

sentences.en: If you don't focus on your classes, your grades will get worse.
alt_en: Unless you focus on your classes, your grades will drop.

sentences.en: If you have a lot of stress, talk to a friend.
alt_en: If you feel very stressed, talk with a friend.

sentences.mn: Тэд намайг хүлээн авбал би зуныг Улаанбаатарт өнгөрүүлнэ.
sentences.en: If they accept me, I will spend the summer in Ulaanbaatar.
alt_en: If they accept me, I'll spend the summer in Ulaanbaatar.
sentences.mn_latin: Ted namaig khüleen avbal bi zunyg Ulaanbaatart öngörüülne.

sentences.en: If you need advice, write on the forum.
alt_mn: Зөвлөгөө хэрэгтэй бол форум дээр бичээрэй.
alt_en: If you need advice, post on the forum.

grammar.explain_en: Mongolian makes 'if' by adding an ending to the verb stem, following vowel harmony: -вал/-вол (back vowels: ажиллавал, асуувал, амарвал), -вэл/-вөл (front vowels: хийвэл, ирвэл, өгвөл). After a stem ending in в, the ending is -бал/-бэл/-бол/-бөл (санаа зовбол, авбал). With a negative, the separate word бол is used: хийхгүй бол. Often хэрэв ('if') starts the clause. 'Unless' is usually expressed with a negative: хийхгүй бол = 'if you don't do'. English uses 'if + present, will + verb' (If you work, you will be tired), and 'unless' = 'if not'.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлний first conditional нь ирээдүйд боломжтой зүйлийг хэлнэ: 'if' + одоо цаг, үндсэн өгүүлбэрт 'will' + үйл үг. Жишээ нь: If you study, you will pass. Ирээдүйн утгатай ч 'if' өгүүлбэрт 'will' хэрэглэхгүй. 'Unless' нь 'if ... not' гэсэн утгатай: Unless you study, you won't pass. Монголоор үүнийг 'хийхгүй бол' гэж хэлнэ. Unless-ийн дараа үгүйсгэл нэмэхгүй.

examples.en: If you do an internship, you will have experience.
If you worry a lot, you won't be able to sleep.
If you don't rest, you will be tired.
If you ask, they will answer.

fill_blank.text: Цагийн ажил хий___ хичээлдээ цаг гарахгүй байж магадгүй.
fill_blank.translation: If you take a part-time job, you may not have time for classes.
fill_blank.explain_en: Хий- has front vowels, so we use -вэл after the vowel-final stem.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Хий' үгийн эгшиг зөөлөн (и) тул -вэл дагавар залгана.

fill_blank.translation: If you ask the teacher, he will explain it.
fill_blank.explain_en: Асуу- has back vowels and ends in a vowel, so it takes -вал.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Асуу' нь хатуу эгшигтэй, эгшгээр төгссөн тул -вал залгана.

fill_blank.translation: If you don't rest well, you will be tired tomorrow.
fill_blank.explain_en: With a negative or past form, we use the separate word бол.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Үгүйсгэсэн болон өнгөрсөн хэлбэрийн дараа тусдаа 'бол' үг бичнэ.

fill_blank.text: If I ___ an internship, I will learn a lot.
fill_blank.translation: Хэрэв би дадлагад орвол их зүйл сурна.
fill_blank.explain_en: In the if-clause use the present simple, not will.

fill_blank.text: You will be tired ___ you rest.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Unless' нь 'if not' буюу 'хийхгүй бол' гэсэн утгатай.

fill_blank.text: If you worry too much, you ___ sleep well.
fill_blank.explain_en: The main clause uses will / won't for the future result.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Үндсэн өгүүлбэрт ирээдүйн үр дүнг 'will / won't'-аар илэрхийлнэ.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Сайн байцгаана уу. Би гуравдугаар курсийн оюутан. Цагийн ажил хийх үү, дадлага хийх үү гэж бодож байна.
dialogue.en: Hello everyone. I'm a third-year student. I'm wondering whether to take a part-time job or do an internship.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baitsgaana uu. Bi guravdugaar kursiin oyuutan. Tsagiin ajil khiikh üü, dadlaga khiikh üü gej bodoj baina.

dialogue.speaker: Билгүүн
dialogue.mn: Дадлага хийвэл ирээдүйд тус болно. Гэхдээ цалин бага байж магадгүй.
dialogue.en: If you do an internship, it will help you in the future. But the pay may be low.
dialogue.mn_latin: Dadlaga khiivel ireedüid tus bolno. Gekhdee tsalin baga baij magadgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ. Мөнгө хэрэгтэй, гэхдээ хичээлдээ ч санаа зовж байна.
dialogue.en: Yes. I need money, but I'm also worried about my classes.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee. Möngö kheregtei, gekhdee khicheeldee ch sanaa zovj baina.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Хэрэв хоёуланг нь хийвэл ядарна. Амрахгүй бол өвдөж магадгүй.
dialogue.en: If you do both, you'll get tired. If you don't rest, you might get sick.
dialogue.mn_latin: Kherev khoyoulang ni khiivel yadarna. Amrakhgüi bol övdöj magadgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Билгүүн
dialogue.mn: Цагийн хуваариа сайн гаргавал бүгдэд амжина.
dialogue.en: If you make a good schedule, you can manage everything.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tsagiin khuvaaria sain gargaval bügded amjina.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Баярлалаа. Багшаасаа асуувал тэр юу гэх бол?
dialogue.en: Thanks. What will my teacher say if I ask?
dialogue.mn_latin: Bayarlalaa. Bagshaasaa asuuval ter yuu gekh bol?

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Асуувал тэр чамд тусална. Зөвлөгөө хэрэгтэй бол дахин бич.
dialogue.en: If you ask, they will help you. If you need more advice, write again.
dialogue.mn_latin: Asuuval ter chamd tusalna. Zövlögöö kheregtei bol dakhin bich.

culture_note.en: Many Mongolian university students in Ulaanbaatar work part-time in cafés, shops, or offices while studying. Student groups on Facebook and Telegram are popular places to ask for advice about classes, jobs, and internships. Older students often share their experience with younger ones.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарын олон оюутан сурч байхдаа кофе шоп, дэлгүүр, оффист цагийн ажил хийдэг. Facebook, Telegram дээрх оюутны группүүд хичээл, ажил, дадлагын талаар зөвлөгөө авах түгээмэл газар юм. Ахлах курсийнхэн ихэвчлэн бага курсийнхэндээ туршлагаа хуваалцдаг.

review.notes: Mostly usable, but the grammar explanation was garbled, some unless/negative pairings mismatched, and a few suffix choices (амарвал) were wrong.

opus_fix.notes: Main problems were the conditional allomorph rule (-бал only after в), the misspelled ядарна, and an ambiguous fill-in-the-blank option.

changes.why: 'нөхцөл гийн' is a garbled form; the correct form is 'нөхцөлийн'.
Амар- takes -вал. The -бал form is only used after в-final stems.
The future form of ядрах is ядарна.
Fixes the ядарна spelling and keeps the same meaning as the main sentence.
The future result needs 'байх болно' to match 'I will be glad'.
The original said -бал/-бэл follows any consonant, gave the wrong form амарбал, and listed back-vowel ярьвал as a front-vowel example.
'don't' also forms a valid sentence (a zero conditional), so the answer was not the only correct option.
